Executive Summary
John Smith presented the annual results of Acme Corp on March 15, 2024.
The company reported strong performance across all divisions, with
particular growth in the enterprise services segment.

Revenue by Quarter
Quarter Revenue Growth
Q1 $9.8M +4%
Q2 $10.4M +6%

target set by the board at the start of the fiscal year.
